subject: Clarify DPA scope for CloudWave onboarding — subprocessor list & eSign preference
messages:
From: Samantha Holt <samantha@cloudwave.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA request: scope, subprocessors, and eSign route for CloudWave onboarding

Hi Irene,

Thanks — we're ready to start vendor onboarding for Redwood. Before we can finish procurement and schedule the integration kickoff, Legal needs a completed DPA and a bit of scope detail so our security team can greenlight the connection. Can you send:

- Redwood's current DPA template (editable preferred)
- A current list or public URL of subprocessors and whether any subprocessors operate outside the EU/UK
- Your default data-transfer mechanism (SCCs, UK Addendum, or other) and whether you can add the UK Addendum if needed
- Your e-sign preference (DocuSign or AdobeSign) — CloudWave prefers DocuSign but we can accommodate AdobeSign if required

A couple of specifics from our side:
- Data: primary customer data is profile and usage telemetry for EU users; we do not send payment PANs to vendors.
- Retention: logs retained up to 90 days; analytics rollups retained longer — I can share a short data flow diagram.
- Timing: we need an executed DPA before our security gate on Monday week (2025-05-12).

I've attached our intake form to make it easier. If you can provide the DPA and confirm e-sign route today, I can circulate to our procurement team.

Best,
Samantha Holt
Legal Operations
CloudWave Inc.
[Attachment: CloudWave-DPA-Intake-Form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Holt <samantha@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2025 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA request: scope, subprocessors, and eSign route for CloudWave onboarding

Samantha — thanks for the clear list. Attaching our standard DPA (editable). Quick notes up front: Redwood typically relies on EU SCCs and offers the UK Addendum on request; we publish a live subprocessor disclosure page (link below) and can provide a timestamped snapshot for your security team. DocuSign is our default for contracts but we can use AdobeSign if preferred.

Two clarifying asks so we include the correct clauses:
1) Confirm whether CloudWave considers the telemetry data "personal data" under your interpretation — helps us pick processing purpose language.
2) Do you need us to state specific subprocessors used for hosting vs monitoring (we can provide both separated)?

I'll loop Laura from Legal to handle any redlines.

Thanks — I can aim to get the redline-ready DPA back within 24 hours once you confirm the two items above.

Irene Choi
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-DPA-v1.2.docx (DOCX)]
Links: https://redwood.ai/subprocessors

From: Samantha Holt <samantha@cloudwave.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 May 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA request: scope, subprocessors, and eSign route for CloudWave onboarding

Hi Irene — quick answers below and attached a simple dataflow diagram:

- Telemetry: yes, our privacy team treats user-level telemetry that can be linked to an account as personal data.
- Subprocesser breakdown: hosting (production) and observability are the main buckets we care about; an explicit list is ideal.
- Retention: logs 90 days, aggregate analytics 2 years.
- eSign: DocuSign preferred.
- Transfers: we would prefer SCCs + UK Addendum if possible; if Redwood has an alternative transfer mechanism, please state it in the DPA.

We need an executed DPA by 2025-05-12 to stay on track. If you send an updated DPA and a DocuSign envelope to me and procurement (procure@cloudwave.com), we can sign quickly.

Thanks — attaching a diagram showing EU data flow into the app and what goes to telemetry vendors.

Samantha Holt
Legal Operations
CloudWave Inc.
[Attachment: CloudWave-Dataflow-Diagram.png (PNG)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Holt <samantha@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 May 2025 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA request: scope, subprocessors, and eSign route for CloudWave onboarding

Hi Samantha — Laura here from Redwood Legal, stepping in to confirm next steps.

Thanks for the details — we can accommodate SCCs with the UK Addendum. A few items:
- We'll produce a redline to Redwood-DPA-v1.2 reflecting the transfer mechanism (SCCs + UK Addendum) and include explicit data categories for telemetry.
- Subprocessor disclosure: we maintain a live list at https://redwood.ai/subprocessors; for onboarding we will provide a timestamped PDF snapshot that separates hosting vs observability vendors.
- eSign: DocuSign works for us. We'll prepare a DocuSign envelope and send it to the addresses you provided (including procure@cloudwave.com).

Next steps (proposed):
1) Redwood sends a redline by EOD Monday (2025-05-05)
2) CloudWave reviews and confirms any commercial redlines; if none, legal teams proceed to DocuSign
3) Once executed, Redwood will push the subprocessor snapshot and add you to our security onboarding checklist

If that timeline works, I will issue the DocuSign envelope and include our HubSpot deal ID for reference (CW-2025-138).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: (none) — will attach redline doc when ready]
